entries.title: Gloomwood

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Steam Early Access current PC build
primary.why: Gloomwood is sourced as a Windows Early Access release; the native PC build is the only documented platform route and keeps the latest content, controls, and capture flexibility.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Gloomwood on Steam for Windows PC and keep it updated for the latest Early Access build.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is an Early Access release, so content and technical behavior may change before 1.0.
